rationale: Six boxes each hold one full sentence of the source, split over two tspans so no label exceeds 8 words; chained boustrophedon, the figure is the prose with borders drawn around it (the textual_overload veto). words_per_label passes; a label that is a sentence (ends in a period, starts with an article/conjunction, carries a finite verb) or a figure whose labels total more words than a short paragraph should trip the veto.
